body.name: Balanced reservoir stable-set capsule
body.construction: Draw up to \(n^3\) uniform \(k\)-subsets \(A\); on the first draw with \(|F_G(A)|\ge k\), draw \(C\) uniformly from the \(k\)-subsets of \(F_G(A)\), swap the roles of \(A\) and \(C\) using \(\omega\), force the closed neighborhoods of \(T\) to treatment and those of \(C_0\) to control, and use fair independent assignments elsewhere; use one fair global arm if all trials fail.
